name: Magical☆Unity
source:
Master got caught by bad guys! Main heroine needs to help him fast by lifting the laid curse. With her magical beam she can pacify any number of enemies one after another. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
师父被坏人抓住了！女主角需要快速帮助他解除诅咒。凭借她的魔法光束，她可以一个又一个地安抚任意数量的敌人。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
